Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by extending the java.lang.Thread class without overriding the run method. As a result, when the start method is called, no action is performed.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the showBug method is called on an instance of MyThread. This method calls the start method, which expects the run method to be overridden in the MyThread class. Since the run method is not overridden, no output is produced when the thread is started, causing the test to fail.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the bug was triggered as the test 'testShowBug' did not produce any output, which is expected because the 'run' method of the 'MyThread' class is not overridden. This confirms the bug as described in the bug information, where classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific 'run' behavior.
